summary.content:
Today's selection covers 81 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 57 on Artificial Intelligence and 14 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Trump backs return of ex-Nvidia boss after 'Bring Jensen Back' campaign launched
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Telegram Widgets Hit by RCE Demos, Malware Warning Days After Launch
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, The Verge, NY Times Tech, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 48 articles published in the last 24 hours
